DeepFilterNet runtime subset for Thiscord

Upstream: https://github.com/Rikorose/DeepFilterNet
Revision: d375b2d8309e0935d165700c91da9de862a99c31
Package: libDF / deep_filter 0.5.7-pre (library name df)
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0; MIT selected for Thiscord distribution.
Unmodified upstream license texts are retained under libDF/.

Copied from the exact revision, with no changes to the Cargo source cache:
  libDF/src/{lib,transforms,tract,logging}.rs
  libDF/{Cargo.toml,LICENSE,LICENSE-MIT,LICENSE-APACHE}
  models/DeepFilterNet3_onnx.tar.gz

Model: 7,983,136 bytes, byte-for-byte upstream archive; no repacking.
SHA-256: c94d91f70911001c946e0fabb4aa9adc37045f45a03b56008cb0c8244cb63616
The relative include_bytes! path in tract.rs is unchanged.

Local changes:
1. lib.rs: in band_unit_norm and band_unit_norm_t, after the recursive state
   update and before sqrt/division, apply:
       if s.is_finite() && *s < f32::MIN_POSITIVE {
           *s = f32::MIN_POSITIVE;
       }
   With FTZ/DAZ, silence previously decayed the state to zero, giving 0/0 at
   block 7774 with alpha=0.99 and the model's smallest initial state. The
   smallest normal positive float prevents that underflow/division failure.
   Comparisons retain NaNs; the finite guard also retains negative infinity
   so its square root remains invalid. No max() NaN masking, FP-mode changes,
   added audio, silence reset, model changes or inference bypass are used.
   Finite negative states are floored too; valid energy states are nonnegative.
2. Cargo.toml: limit this private vendor subset to the rlib and the supported
   default-model, transforms, logging, timings and tract features. Retain the
   exact upstream constraints/flags for every retained dependency. Remove CLI,
   dataset/training, codecs, C API, WASM binding, allocator, alternate-model
   features and their unused dependencies/packaging metadata. Default features
   retain default-model only; Thiscord explicitly disables defaults and enables
   tract + default-model, just as before vendoring. Frontend tract entry points
   remain pinned to =0.21.4, and the lockfile preserves all resolved versions.
3. lib.rs: remove module declarations for omitted features and the upstream
   rand-based test module. transforms.rs: omit its upstream test module, which
   requires dataset utilities, WAV helpers and external audio fixtures. The
   frontend's optimized tests exercise this dependency, including long-silence
   inference, both normalization layouts, invalid state and reset behavior.
4. tract.rs: remove the alternate low-latency model branch and simplify the
   default-model/capi cfg now that capi is omitted. The DFN3 branch and runtime
   logic are unchanged. logging.rs is byte-for-byte upstream.

This is intentionally not a full upstream development checkout. Other models,
Python/training packages, datasets, command-line tools and fixtures are omitted;
unsupported features are absent rather than exposed with missing files.
The root Cargo.toml patches the pinned Git source to this path and excludes the
vendored package from workspace membership, preserving the three app packages.

To audit, compare the listed files against the pinned upstream revision. Model
and license hashes must match upstream. Only the two state floors above change
the runtime math; other source edits remove unavailable modules/tests/features.
